top3.headline: Claude's API now keeps conversation threads on Anthropic's servers
top3.whyItMatters: Agent apps send only new messages each turn, so Claude starts responding sooner.

top3.headline: MIT team shows GPT-6 Astra editing model weights directly, no training
top3.whyItMatters: Fixing a model by editing a sliver of its weights could cut the cost of tuning models.

top3.headline: Oracle raises $20B in stock and bonds for its AI buildout
top3.whyItMatters: A major AI cloud vendor is leaning on capital markets, so weigh its balance sheet in contracts.

items.title: Claude Messages API adds server-side threads in public beta
items.takeaway: Clients send only new messages plus the previous message ID.
items.soWhat: Teams building on Claude can cut resent context and get faster first responses in long sessions.

items.title: Claude Code now steers away from cloning specific existing games
items.takeaway: Anthropic added two prompt sentences on Opus 5.5; original and genre games still work.
items.soWhat: Coding agents now enforce IP policy in the prompt, so expect refusals on clone-style requests.

items.title: Vercel now blocks known malicious npm packages during builds
items.takeaway: Blocking happens before install scripts run, with no setup needed.
items.soWhat: Supply-chain defense is moving into the platform, but it only covers packages already known as malicious.

items.title: OpenAI pledges to free up to 1,000 MW for the grid
items.takeaway: Pilot at a planned data center in Effingham County, Georgia, during emergencies.
items.soWhat: Power is now a public bargaining chip for AI campuses, and local approval depends on it.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen's weights, MATH-500 jumps to 48%
items.takeaway: MIT CSAIL calls it Weight-Space Programming: edits in plain reasoning, no gradients.
items.soWhat: If models can repair other models directly, fine-tuning may get cheaper and faster to iterate.

items.title: NYT and three papers sue Brave over scraping sold to AI firms
items.takeaway: Complaint names Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI and Cohere as index buyers.
items.soWhat: Check where your AI vendors' web data comes from, since publishers now sue the suppliers.

items.title: Oracle files to sell $20B in stock and notes for AI
items.takeaway: Shares fell 8.8%; debt was $125.34B as of Aug. 31.
items.soWhat: If Oracle hosts your AI workloads, track its financing, since its credit risk has risen sharply.

items.title: Poisoning 0.1% of pretraining data plants a backdoor in CLI agents
items.takeaway: The backdoor survived clean post-training; the 4B model hit about 92% attack success.
items.soWhat: Ask model vendors how they vet pretraining data before giving agents shell access.

hotOnX.note: People are startled that a model can repair another model without any training run.

hotOnX.text: Applications open for the Anthropic Residency, a paid research program; no ML background required
hotOnX.note: A paid route into frontier research without an ML background draws wide interest.

hotOnX.text: Message threads in public beta on the Claude Messages API: send only new messages plus the previous message ID
hotOnX.note: Builders want faster, cheaper long conversations without resending history every turn.
